items.title: 14 Killed in Weapons Depot Blast in Northwest Syria
items.summary: Officials said they had not determined the cause of the explosion. Years of fighting have left Syria littered with weapons and ordnance left over from the civil war.

items.title: Spain Declassifies Warning to Morocco About Migrant Crossing Plans
items.summary: Spain’s intelligence service had alerted Morocco about social media calls for a border exodus into Ceuta, which led to more than 100 deaths and a political crisis in Spain.

items.title: How a Driver’s Sudden Death Triggered Ebola Panic in Congo
items.summary: When a truck driver unexpectedly collapsed and died in a remote village, frontline medical staff scrambled to safely isolate his body, triggering a standoff.

items.title: Yemen Tilts Toward Full-Scale War as Saudi-Houthi Clashes Escalate
items.summary: With its oil-export routes once again under threat, Saudi Arabia is stepping up its military campaign against an old antagonist.

items.title: Europe Unites to Pressure Israel, Breaking With U.S.

items.title: U.S. Takes Aim at New Target in Deadly Boat Strike Campaign

items.title: Police Expand Investigation Into Reform U.K. After Undercover Sting

items.title: Joseph Rice, Lowcountry Lawyer Who Took On Big Tobacco, Dies at 72
